description: Build and apply a Movements profile (the rules governing how the bot may traverse the world: digging, parkour, towers, doors, costs, and block allow/deny lists). Applies to the pathfinder by default, or to pvp/collectblock movements via `scope`.

blocksCantBreak.description: Block names the bot must never break

blocksToAvoid.description: Block names the bot should avoid stepping on

scaffoldingBlocks.description: Block names usable as scaffolding to bridge/tower

scope.description: Where to apply the profile (default pathfinder)

name: configure_movements
